newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY BCE MAIZE FUTURES DROP,MILLING WHEAT MIXED.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY BCE MAIZE FUTURES DROP,MILLING WHEAT MIXED.

text.p: Maize futures on the Budapest Commodities Exchange (BCE) continued to slide for the second day running on Wednesday, traders said.
"Market players are having difficulty in finding the appropriate price level," said Sandor Torok of Agrokont.
Maize futures dropped for all traded 1997 maturities by 50 to 400 forints, while the December 1996 maturity rose 400 to end at 19,100 forints.
Milling wheat for December ended at 28,980 forints, down 420, but rose by 450 forints for December 1997 to close at 24,800 forints.
"There is little information about next year's planting to trade on," Torok said.
Feed barley prices dropped for July and August 1997 by 400 and 200 forints respectively, to finish at 21,200 and 21,400 forints.
Maize futures contracts accounted for 528 of the total 1,178 contracts or 527 million forints turnover of the BCE grain section, a below average level, traders said.
Lot size is 20,000 kgs for all contracts.
